title: P0.80: Metacognitive local LLM contract
description: Expand local-chat eligibility and system prompting so self-awareness, metacognition, strategy, support, and local research questions use the local LLM with live-system grounding instead of generic templates.
reason: The downloaded metacognition prompt was not implemented: only knowledge.query/general.assistance were LLM-eligible, SystemPromptBuilder lacked a compact prompt for small models, and governance could let stale external blocks contaminate introspective questions.
next_action: Live Windows proof: ask 'me entiendes y que evidencia tienes' and 'por donde vamos' in IABV. The answer should be produced by local_chat_llm with system_prompt_mode compact/full metadata and should not be blocked by stale ChatGPT security incidents.
resume_hint: P0.80 implements expanded _LOCAL_CHAT_INTENT_KEYS, SystemPromptBuilder.build_compact(), operational permissions in identity prompt, and early local governance for system.self_awareness/system.metacognition.
